description: This file defines a PHP function 'additionalDetailsBug' that generates and returns a string containing HTML-formatted bug details, intended for display in a UI tooltip or overlay within the SuiteCRM system. It dynamically constructs content based on provided bug fields and localization strings.

methods.name: additionalDetailsBug
methods.description: Generates a formatted string with bug details for display, including fields like DATE_ENTERED, SOURCE, PRODUCT_CATEGORY, RESOLUTION, DESCRIPTION, and WORK_LOG, with truncation for lengthy text.
